scope: Actual bounded recovered reservation observation and exact idempotent bootstrap retirement. Not server-backend exclusion, complete installed initializer/recovery CLI, persistent Archive service or M1.
design: Immutable actual-reacquisition flag distinguishes recovered custody from consumed provisioning/native launch flags; neither recovery operation grants a new credential or native launch.

The same exclusive catalog transaction advisory lock serializes old provisioning/retirement and fresh observation. Observation returns only fixed OIDs/names/nonce plus retired state and requires successful ROLLBACK.

Canonical global comment comparison happens on the server. Comments above128 bytes return ResourceLimit; missing/noncanonical values and partial role pairs return Conflict. No verifier/password/arbitrary comment crosses observation.
Both reserved names absent means current absence only and also requires pristine database. It does not prove provisioning never committed or permit reuse/relaunch.

Retirement revalidates every Reservation field and current comment/role restrictions before either ALTER ROLE or idempotent return; only the exact bootstrap changes to NOLOGIN PASSWORD NULL. Permanent reservation and role names remain.

First observation reads the current reservation OID; comment v1 binds bootstrap/manager OIDs, not its own OID. Known retirement refuses replaced reservation OID; privileged forgery/replacement of all retained metadata remains outside ordinary trusted administrator failures.

Observer accepts active LOGIN/nonnull password or retired NOLOGIN/NULL only and permits manager ownership of already installed native tables. Mixed credential states and unsafe attributes/memberships/effective PUBLIC privileges refuse.
methods: Mac is the sole editing/Git workspace. Each unpublished clean candidate was transferred by Git bundle and exported to read-only native build inputs. Three independently regenerated Mac git archives are compared with every native source hash.

Trusted Tux uses tools.build and tools.ci.execute for actual main/worker ordered builds, actual probe build, storage::archive parent tests and scoped parent/worker Clippy. Hosted Actions billing remains unavailable.
Fresh owned internal PostgreSQL16.15/SCRAM labs, no host ports. Runner2CPU/6GiB/512PIDs and PG1CPU/1GiB/128PIDs. Same Linux boot/ext4 only. No release keys or untrusted PR code.

Independent psql derives expected OIDs; expected field dictionaries do not reuse Rust observation. Full pg_dump comparisons strip only random restrict/unrestrict tokens. Whole role/membership/comment hashes include row xmin and secret hashes without transferring verifiers.

Known retirement and strengthened ambiguous cases verify the exact role LOGIN/password state independently, unchanged DB and all unrelated role attributes/memberships/comments. Idempotent/refusal cases require whole-state equality including xmin.

Actual generated bootstrap password initializes the six scientific relations. Separate exact retirement and guarded manager installation precede recovered observation; actual table owners are independently checked. This is a fixture composition, not installed CLI.

Fault proxy drops COMMIT before forwarding or after server completion, yielding CommitUnknown in both cases. Fresh actual observer under recovered custody resolves state; retry retires once or returns unchanged.

Cancellation times out the real retirement future with COMMIT held remotely, aborts and positively joins the actual custody-bearing driver, then exits. A new observer reacquires actual local custody and is independently observed waiting on the authoritative advisory lock. Closing/releasing the intermediary resolves rollback/late commit. Timing only triggers the fault; lock and durable SQL establish outcome.
